what: Bloodridge journey, take 3 (21 Oct): one strip, four places, march between them, built on Jacob's three layer rule. Mock values for Codex to wire; Jacob approves.

layers.1_static: bloodridge-stops-strip.png: scenery and battle floor, 1x. Each stop's view is a 1376x768 crop at (x, tilt), shown in the stage at (32,66) of the 1440x900 fight frame.

2_minimal_animation.ash: 300 specks of 1 to 2 px in three tones (222,206,184), (178,155,134), (92,78,80); drift left 14 to 34 px/s, sink 2 to 6 px/s, sway 1 to 3 px at 0.4 to 0.9 Hz; world anchored; only in the top 285 stage rows, behind the fighters, like the court's own ash; denser in the outskirts (1.0), grove 0.7, crypt 0.3, court 0.6
2_minimal_animation.banners: bloodridge-banner-cult.png and -2.png alternate at 4 fps on cleared places
2_minimal_animation.court: the court's own linen loop and near layer from Assets/StreamingAssets/CampaignArt/Bloodridge, as the game draws them, in front of the fighters

layers.3_battle: fighters on the open floor; every back row stands below the scenery line at all four stops

road_mapping: rows 1 to 3 of a tribe's road map to stops 1 to 3 whatever the lane; the chief's node is stop 4

march.camera: the army keeps its formation on screen; the strip slides under it; tilt eases between stops; scroll only goes forward
march.legs: run frames advance with ground covered, one frame per measured stride, not per tick; idle below 25 px/s
march.posture: starting values to test by watching, not sourced

fight_lock.orders_bar: from 0.3 s before the fight to the clear

states.chief: red diamond from the start, gold when cleared
